claim_boundary: E1 is a bounded engineering experiment measuring directional learning value of executable-semantics curriculum over a task-matched conventional control. The result is NO_OBSERVED_SIGNAL: no arm acquired the response task, no relative safety regression was observed under the frozen safety metric, and no directional Foundry improvement was detected. This does not establish that executable-semantics curriculum lacks value at larger scale. It establishes that this exact model x recipe x budget did not reach a learnability floor sufficient to test curriculum separation. This experiment does not measure reasoning improvement, curriculum efficacy, transfer, statistical power, or scale readiness.

classification_logic.applied: safety_nonregression=true, P_foundry NOT > P_control, P_foundry NOT > P_base
classification_logic.rule: NO_OBSERVED_SIGNAL when technically valid and not HARMFUL and not PROMISING
